items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: when I played in Mangal's place at the economy hall... You said you substituted for Perez when he couldn't make it... Now and then.

ctx.x: What about, say you're playing economy hall, Jean-Sami, Franz-Ami, all those halls, you played them?

That's where I made my reputation, Franz-Ami. Franz-Ami. Yeah. Jean-Sami I played that too. But Franz-Ami, that's where I made my reputation. Because they had that number that it was only Mangal Perez that could make that run on that instrument, on that trumpet. No others couldn't make it. And I heard Mangal made it one time, and right there I had it. And believe me, when I played in Mangal's place at the economy hall on Oyseline Street, I made that run, and those Creole downtown spread my name spread all over…
What was the run like? How did it go?
